title: Leeroy Jenkins
blurb: LEEEEROY JENKINSSS — the battle cry that ruined a meticulously-planned World of Warcraft raid in 2005 and became one of the internet's founding legends. It's the sound of abandoning strategy entirely in favour of enthusiasm. Play it before any reckless charge into a situation nobody prepared for. At least he has chicken.
origin: From the legendary 2005 World of Warcraft raid video.
